title: Danielle Smith boots separatist leader out of Conservative party
description: ( LifeSiteNews ) — Alberta Premier Danielle Smith confirmed that she has kicked out of her party one of the main separatist leaders and organizers who led the charge for the province to separate from Canada over irregularities in his overall conduct. On October 29, United Conservative Party (UCP) executive director Dustin van Vugt told the party’s board of directors that Jeff Rath was no longer a UCP member. … Rath, a lawyer, helped the group Stay Free Alberta. Along with the Alberta Prosperity Project, both groups last year drove a petition with thousands of signatures demanding that Smith hold an independence referendum. Overall, about 25 percent of Albertans voted to hold a referendum to leave Canada. The calls for Alberta’s independence have grown since Liberal Prime Minister Mark Carney defeated Conservative rival Pierre Poilievre in the 2025 federal election. In Alberta, almost all of the seats except two went to the Conservatives.

title: Trump releases messages for All Saints, Protestant Reformation Day
description: ( LifeSiteNews ) — President Donald Trump’s White House released two statements over the weekend commemorating Catholic All Saints Day on Sunday, a day after releasing a similar statement in honor of Protestant Reformation Day on Saturday. In his November 1 statement , Trump lauded the extraordinary lives of the “men and women” who have led “extraordinary lives” throughout the centuries and highlighted several American saints as well as those with American cities named after them.
